title: Squirrel dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail: big bushy, behind body, warm orange -->
  <path d='M60 70 C78 74 90 58 84 40 C80 26 66 20 58 30 C68 32 74 42 70 52 C67 60 63 64 58 64 Z' fill='#e07b2a'/>
  <path d='M62 66 C76 68 85 56 80 42' fill='none' stroke='#f6a04d' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- dancing legs -->
  <path d='M40 78 L30 90' stroke='#b4541a' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 78 L68 88' stroke='#b4541a' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='92' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#8a3d10'/>
  <ellipse cx='71' cy='90' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#8a3d10'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='64' rx='16' ry='17' fill='#e07b2a'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='66' rx='10' ry='11' fill='#f6b06a'/>
  <!-- dancing arms up -->
  <path d='M35 58 L20 44' stroke='#b4541a' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M61 58 L76 46' stroke='#b4541a' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='42' r='4' fill='#8a3d10'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='44' r='4' fill='#8a3d10'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='36' r='14' fill='#e07b2a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M38 24 L36 14 L44 22 Z' fill='#e07b2a'/>
  <path d='M58 24 L62 14 L66 23 Z' fill='#e07b2a'/>
  <path d='M39 24 L38 18 L42 23 Z' fill='#f6b06a'/>
  <path d='M59 23 L61 17 L63 23 Z' fill='#f6b06a'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='42' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#f6b06a'/>
  <!-- eyes: happy -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='34' r='2.6' fill='#3a1a08'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='34' r='2.6' fill='#3a1a08'/>
  <circle cx='43.8' cy='33.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffe6c8'/>
  <circle cx='53.8' cy='33.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffe6c8'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='40' rx='2.4' ry='1.8' fill='#8a3d10'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 44 Q48 47 52 44' fill='none' stroke='#8a3d10' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- music notes floating -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='26' r='2.6' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
  <path d='M24.4 25 L24.4 17' stroke='#7fd4ff' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='24' r='2.6' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <path d='M78.4 23 L78.4 15' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
